description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthClientAPI class, which implements API endpoints for managing OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OAuth clients, along with validation rules and utility functions. The class utilizes traits and external classes for OAuth service integration, data validation, and response formatting.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing OAuth client entities, providing CRUD operations and validation within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all OAuth clients with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new OAuth client, generating secrets if confidentiality is enabled.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified OAuth clients based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing OAuth client, managing secret regeneration if confidentiality status changes.

methods.name: generateSecret
methods.description: Generates a secure random secret string for OAuth clients.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing OAuth clients, primarily for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new OAuth client, including required fields and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method returning validation rules applicable to OAuth client request bodies.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete requests, ensuring proper IDs are supplied.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a specific OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an OAuth client, including ensuring ID validity and handling unique property constraints.

methods.name: setOAuthClient
methods.description: Populates OAuthClient entity properties from request parameters for create/update operations.
